location.address: 2/F, Harbourview Plaza, 88 Queen's Road Central, Central, Hong Kong
location.mtr: Central Station Exit D2 · about 3 minutes' walk
location.parking: Paid car park in the building (no validation)
location.access: Lobby lifts to 2/F; sign in at reception

allergy.summary_en: Nut-aware centre: no peanut/tree-nut sharing snacks; list allergies on enrolment; bring labelled emergency meds if prescribed.

illness.stay_home_rule: Keep children home with fever of 38°C or above; return after 24 hours fever-free without medicine.
illness.makeup: Tell us within 24 hours when possible so we can arrange a make-up under the absence policy.

teachers.summary: Bilingual educators with early-years / primary experience; in-house safeguarding modules.
highlights: Ms. Priya Das — Writing studio (MA Creative Writing)
Mr. Tom Reyes — Early Math (BEd Mathematics)
Ms. Maya Cheung / Ms. Sofia Almeida — Playgroup (first-aid / EYFS)

pickup.playgroup_stay: Playgroup (under ~3): one parent/carer may stay for settling-in as agreed.
pickup.other_wait: Other programmes: parents usually wait outside so children can focus.
pickup.arrive: Arrive from 5 minutes before the lesson ends; teachers dismiss at the classroom door.
pickup.late: Late supervision until 18:15 weekdays / 16:15 Saturdays; after that HK$50 per 15 minutes may apply.
pickup.authorised: Helpers/grandparents may collect only if listed as authorised collectors.

makeup.weather_no_quota: Black Rain / Typhoon No. 8+ / public holiday closures do not consume make-up quota.
makeup.window: Make-ups must be taken within the course period (not carried to next term).
